hints.title: Strictly Increasing Group Sizes
hints.text: Groups must have strictly increasing student counts: 1, 2, 3, ..., k students.

hints.title: Sum Constraint Feasibility
hints.text: By sorting grades ascending, earlier groups of smaller sizes naturally achieve strictly smaller total grade sums.

hints.title: Triangular Number Upper Bound
hints.text: We need the maximum integer k such that k * (k + 1) // 2 <= n.

hints.title: Quadratic Root Formula Implementation

complexity.notes: Closed form integer square root evaluation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the full array takes O(n log n) when only array length matters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the grade values themselves do not constrain the maximum group count.
